Description:
Our Techunifi team recently finished deploying a modern Unonet network at Tru by Hilton Meridian, significantly upgrading the property's digital infrastructure for peak performance.

Another successful project completed by Techunifi! We’re proud to support the Tru by Hilton Meridian team and look forward to keeping their technology running reliably.

Our Techunifi team completed the low-voltage installation, providing a reliable communication and security infrastructure to support the property’s daily operations. From structured cabling and phone system installation to security camera setup, our crew made sure everything was properly installed, connected, and working smoothly.

We’re proud to support the SpringHill Suites Boone team and look forward to keeping their communication running reliably.

Our Techunifi team completed the low-voltage hardware installation at Home2 Suites by Hilton in Pittsburg, CA, building a clean and reliable technology foundation for the property. From telecom racks and patch panels to cable management, structured cabling, and network outlets, our crew made sure everything was organized, scalable, and ready to support the property’s technology needs.

Another property connected and ready to go! Congratulations to the Home2 Suites team, and thank you for trusting Techunifi with your technology needs.

Our Techunifi team completed the IT setup for the property’s new opening, ensuring a reliable and efficient technology infrastructure to support daily operations. From servers, workstations, and laptops to network switches, SD-WAN/firewall, printers, and battery backup systems, our crew made sure everything was installed, configured, and running smoothly.

We’re proud to support the property’s launch and provide ongoing managed IT support to keep its technology running reliably.
